symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_ORB
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Port B / AY1 control: PB0=BC1, PB1=BDIR, PB2=/RESET; $04 inactive, $05 read, $06 write, $07 latch address; PB2=0 resets AY

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_ORA
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Port A / AY1 8-bit register-address and data bus; ORB selects latch, read or write operation

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_DDRB
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Port B data direction: bit=1 output, bit=0 input; PB0-PB2 drive AY1 control lines

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_DDRA
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Port A data direction: $FF outputs register/data bytes to AY1; $00 inputs AY register readback

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_T1CL
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Timer 1 counter low (read clears T1 interrupt flag); write updates timer latch low

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_T1CH
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Timer 1 counter high; write loads/restarts T1 from the latch and clears T1 interrupt flag

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_T1LL
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Timer 1 latch low: read/write low byte of the timer reload value

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_T1LH
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Timer 1 latch high: write updates reload high byte and clears T1 interrupt flag without starting T1

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_T2CL
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Timer 2 counter low (read clears T2 interrupt flag); write sets timer latch low

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_T2CH
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Timer 2 counter high; write loads/starts T2 and clears T2 interrupt flag

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_SR
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Shift register: serial data under ACR control; usually unused for AY sound

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_ACR
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Auxiliary control: T1 one-shot/free-run and PB7 output, T2 timed/pulse-count mode, shift mode and input latching

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_PCR
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Peripheral control: CA1/CA2 and CB1/CB2 interrupt-edge, handshake and output modes

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_IFR
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Interrupt flags: bit7=enabled IRQ summary; bits6..0=T1,T2,CB1,CB2,SR,CA1,CA2; write 1 clears a flag

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_IER
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Interrupt enable: bits6..0 select interrupt sources; write bit7=1 enables selected bits, bit7=0 disables; read bit7=1

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB1_ORA_NH
symbols.comment: Mockingboard VIA 1: Port A / AY1 data bus without CA1/CA2 handshake effects

symbols.name: COMMENT_MB2_ORB
